instruction:
Build a full-stack Inventory and Order Management web application using Python Flask and SQLite. The application should allow warehouse staff to track products (name, SKU, category, quantity, unit price), record incoming/outgoing stock movements, and view low-stock alerts. Structure the project into separate files:
1. database.py - SQLite database connection, table initialization (products and inventory_logs), and helper queries.
2. app.py - Flask web server with API endpoints for listing products, adding new items, updating stock counts, and rendering templates.
3. templates/index.html - Modern HTML5 dashboard with inventory tables, summary metric cards, and a modal form for product entry.
4. static/style.css - Polished, responsive design with clean tables, badges, alert indicators, and card layouts.
5. static/script.js - Client-side JavaScript using the Fetch API to perform asynchronous CRUD actions without page reloads.

import sqlite3 from contextlib import contextmanager DB_NAME = 'inventory.db' @contextmanager def get_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_NAME) conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row try: yield conn conn.commit() except Exception: conn.rollback() raise finally: conn.close() def init_db(): with get_db() as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, sku TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ''') cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_logs ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, change_amount INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) ''') from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify from database import init_db, get_db import sqlite3 app = Flask(__name__) init_db() @app.route('/') def index(): return render_template('index.html') @app.route('/api/products', methods=['GET']) def list_products(): with get_db() as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY id DESC') return jsonify([dict(r) for r in cursor.fetchall()]) @app.route('/api/products', methods=['POST']) def create_product(): data = request.get_json() or {} try: with get_db() as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute( 'INSERT INTO products (name, sku, category, quantity, unit_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', (data['name'], data['sku'].upper(), data['category'], int(data.get('quantity', 0)), float(data.get('unit_price', 0))) ) pid = cursor.lastrowid cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', (pid,)) return jsonify(dict(cursor.fetchone())), 201 except sqlite3.IntegrityError: return jsonify({'error': 'SKU already exists'}), 409 @app.route('/api/products//adjust', methods=['POST']) def adjust_stock(pid): delta = request.get_json().get('delta', 0) with get_db() as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute('UPDATE products SET quantity = quantity + ? WHERE id = ?', (delta, pid)) cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', (pid,)) return jsonify(dict(cursor.fetchone())) StockFlow Inventory

instruction:
Create a Kanban Task Board web application using FastAPI and SQLite. The app must support organizing tasks across three columns: 'Todo', 'In Progress', and 'Done'. Users should be able to create tasks with title, description, and priority, move them between columns, and delete tasks. Implement the code across these files:
- database.py: SQLite connection and schema setup for the tasks table.
- main.py: FastAPI app with routes for static files, HTML template, and JSON REST endpoints.
- templates/index.html: 3-column Kanban layout with draggable or button-based task progression.
- static/style.css: Flexbox board styling with distinct column headers and priority tags.
- static/script.js: Fetch API logic to load cards, change column status, and post new tasks.
output:
import sqlite3 DB_PATH = 'kanban.db' def get_conn(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return conn def init_db(): with get_conn() as conn: conn.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, priority TEXT DEFAULT 'Medium', status TEXT DEFAULT 'todo' ) ''') from fastapi import FastAPI, Request from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from pydantic import BaseModel from database import get_conn, init_db app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class TaskCreate(BaseModel): title: str description: str = '' priority: str = 'Medium' class StatusUpdate(BaseModel): status: str @app.get('/', response_class=HTMLResponse) def home(request: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': request}) @app.get('/api/tasks') def get_tasks(): with get_conn() as conn: rows = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM tasks').fetchall() return [dict(r) for r in rows] @app.post('/api/tasks') def create_task(task: TaskCreate): with get_conn() as conn: cur = conn.execute('INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, priority) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (task.title, task.description, task.priority)) return {'id': cur.lastrowid, **task.dict(), 'status': 'todo'} @app.patch('/api/tasks/{task_id}') def update_task_status(task_id: int, update: StatusUpdate): with get_conn() as conn: conn.execute('UPDATE tasks SET status = ? WHERE id = ?', (update.status, task_id)) return {'status': 'updated'} @app.delete('/api/tasks/{task_id}') def delete_task(task_id: int): with get_conn() as conn: conn.execute('DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id = ?', (task_id,)) return {'deleted': task_id} Kanban Flow

instruction:
Create a Markdown Note-Taking and Tagging web app using Flask and SQLite. Users can write notes with titles, markdown content, and tags. Provide endpoints to filter notes by tag, search note contents, and delete notes. Split into:
- database.py: SQLite setup with notes and tags tables.
- app.py: Flask endpoints for CRUD and search.
- templates/index.html: Note composer and notes feed.
- static/style.css: Minimalist notebook aesthetic with sidebar tags.
- static/script.js: Client-side note fetching, real-time tag filtering, and deletion.
output:
import sqlite3 def get_db(): c = sqlite3.connect('notes.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_db() as conn: conn.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, tag TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )''') from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify from database import get_db, init_db app = Flask(__name__) init_db() @app.route('/') def home(): return render_template('index.html') @app.route('/api/notes', methods=['GET']) def list_notes(): tag = request.args.get('tag') with get_db() as conn: if tag and tag != 'ALL': rows = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM notes WHERE tag = ? ORDER BY id DESC', (tag,)).fetchall() else: rows = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM notes ORDER BY id DESC').fetchall() return jsonify([dict(r) for r in rows]) @app.route('/api/notes', methods=['POST']) def save_note(): d = request.json with get_db() as conn: cur = conn.execute('INSERT INTO notes (title, content, tag) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (d['title'], d['content'], d.get('tag', 'general'))) return jsonify({'id': cur.lastrowid}), 201 @app.route('/api/notes/', methods=['DELETE']) def del_note(nid): with get_db() as conn: conn.execute('DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?', (nid,)) return jsonify({'success': True}) Notes Vault

instruction:
Build a Personal Budget and Expense Tracker using Flask and SQLite. The app tracks financial transactions (type: income or expense, amount, category, date, description) and calculates net balance, total income, and total expenses. Split the code into:
1. database.py - Database connection and schema for transactions.
2. app.py - Endpoints to add, delete, and list transactions, plus summary metrics.
3. templates/index.html - Financial overview dashboard with summary balance cards and transaction log.
4. static/style.css - Polished fintech cards with green income and red expense styling.
5. static/script.js - Fetch API calls for transaction submission and dynamic calculation updates.

import sqlite3 def get_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect('budget.db') conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return conn def init_db(): with get_db() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, type TEXT CHECK(type IN ('income', 'expense')), category TEXT NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL, description TEXT, created_at DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE )''') from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify from database import get_db, init_db app = Flask(__name__) init_db() @app.route('/') def index(): return render_template('index.html') @app.route('/api/transactions', methods=['GET']) def get_trans(): with get_db() as conn: rows = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM transactions ORDER BY id DESC').fetchall() return jsonify([dict(r) for r in rows]) @app.route('/api/transactions', methods=['POST']) def add_trans(): d = request.json with get_db() as conn: conn.execute('INSERT INTO transactions (type, category, amount, description) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (d['type'], d['category'], float(d['amount']), d.get('description', ''))) return jsonify({'status': 'ok'}), 201 @app.route('/api/transactions/', methods=['DELETE']) def delete_trans(tid): with get_db() as conn: conn.execute('DELETE FROM transactions WHERE id = ?', (tid,)) return jsonify({'deleted': tid}) Budget Tracker

instruction:
Create a Recipe Box & Meal Planner web application with FastAPI and SQLite. Users can view recipes, add new culinary creations (title, prep time, ingredients list, cooking instructions, cuisine tag), and search by ingredient or cuisine. Structure:
- database.py: SQLite setup for recipes table.
- main.py: FastAPI app serving Jinja2 template and REST API routes.
- templates/index.html: Recipe card gallery and modal creation form.
- static/style.css: Warm culinary-themed responsive card grid.
- static/script.js: Fetch API integration for async search and submission.

import sqlite3 def get_conn(): c = sqlite3.connect('recipes.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_conn() as conn: conn.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recipes ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, cuisine TEXT NOT NULL, prep_time INTEGER NOT NULL, ingredients TEXT NOT NULL, instructions TEXT NOT NULL )''') from fastapi import FastAPI, Request from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pydantic import BaseModel from database import get_conn, init_db app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class RecipeSchema(BaseModel): title: str cuisine: str prep_time: int ingredients: str instructions: str @app.get('/') def home(req: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': req}) @app.get('/api/recipes') def get_recipes(q: str = ''): with get_conn() as conn: if q: rows = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM recipes WHERE title LIKE ? OR ingredients LIKE ?', (f'%{q}%', f'%{q}%')).fetchall() else: rows = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM recipes ORDER BY id DESC').fetchall() return [dict(r) for r in rows] @app.post('/api/recipes') def add_recipe(rec: RecipeSchema): with get_conn() as conn: cur = conn.execute('INSERT INTO recipes (title, cuisine, prep_time, ingredients, instructions) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)', (rec.title, rec.cuisine, rec.prep_time, rec.ingredients, rec.instructions)) return {'id': cur.lastrowid} Recipe Box

instruction:
Build a Habit Tracker web application using Python Flask and SQLite. Users can create daily habits (name, goal category, target frequency), check off completed habits for today, and calculate continuous streaks. Organize into:
- database.py: DB models and check-in logs.
- app.py: Flask routes for habit status and check-ins.
- templates/index.html: Daily tracker interface with streak indicators.
- static/style.css: Modern checklist aesthetic with progress badges.
- static/script.js: Client-side habit toggling and dynamic streak calculation.
output:
import sqlite3 def get_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect('habits.db') conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return conn def init_db(): with get_db() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS habits ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, streak INTEGER DEFAULT 0, last_completed DATE )''') from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify from database import get_db, init_db from datetime import date app = Flask(__name__) init_db() @app.route('/') def index(): return render_template('index.html') @app.route('/api/habits', methods=['GET']) def get_habits(): with get_db() as c: return jsonify([dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM habits').fetchall()]) @app.route('/api/habits', methods=['POST']) def add_habit(): name = request.json.get('name') with get_db() as c: cur = c.execute('INSERT INTO habits (name) VALUES (?)', (name,)) return jsonify({'id': cur.lastrowid, 'name': name, 'streak': 0}), 201 @app.route('/api/habits//checkin', methods=['POST']) def checkin(hid): today = str(date.today()) with get_db() as c: h = c.execute('SELECT * FROM habits WHERE id = ?', (hid,)).fetchone() if h['last_completed'] == today: return jsonify({'msg': 'Already done today'}), 400 c.execute('UPDATE habits SET streak = streak + 1, last_completed = ? WHERE id = ?', (today, hid)) return jsonify({'status': 'streak increased'}) Daily Habit Streak

Daily Habits

Create a lightweight CRM & Sales Pipeline application using FastAPI and SQLite. Users can track leads (contact name, company, email, deal value, stage: 'Lead', 'Contacted', 'Proposal', 'Won', 'Lost'). Include routes to filter leads by stage and update their status. Required files:
- database.py: SQLite connection and leads table setup.
- main.py: FastAPI app with REST routes and template rendering.
- templates/index.html: CRM table and pipeline summary.
- static/style.css: Business CRM style with stage status badges.
- static/script.js: Dynamic lead stage changes via Fetch API.

import sqlite3 def get_conn(): c = sqlite3.connect('crm.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leads ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, company TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL, value REAL DEFAULT 0.0, stage TEXT DEFAULT 'Lead' )''') from fastapi import FastAPI, Request from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pydantic import BaseModel from database import get_conn, init_db app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class LeadCreate(BaseModel): name: str company: str email: str value: float stage: str = 'Lead' @app.get('/') def home(req: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': req}) @app.get('/api/leads') def list_leads(): with get_conn() as c: return [dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM leads ORDER BY id DESC').fetchall()] @app.post('/api/leads') def add_lead(lead: LeadCreate): with get_conn() as c: cur = c.execute('INSERT INTO leads (name, company, email, value, stage) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)', (lead.name, lead.company, lead.email, lead.value, lead.stage)) return {'id': cur.lastrowid} @app.patch('/api/leads/{lid}') def update_stage(lid: int, stage: str): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('UPDATE leads SET stage = ? WHERE id = ?', (stage, lid)) return {'ok': True} Mini CRM

import sqlite3 def get_conn(): c = sqlite3.connect('polls.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS polls ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, question TEXT NOT NULL )''') c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS options ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, poll_id INTEGER NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, votes INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )''') from fastapi import FastAPI, Request from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pydantic import BaseModel from database import get_conn, init_db app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class PollCreate(BaseModel): question: str options: list[str] @app.get('/') def index(req: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': req}) @app.get('/api/polls') def get_polls(): with get_conn() as c: polls = [dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM polls').fetchall()] for p in polls: p['options'] = [dict(o) for o in c.execute('SELECT * FROM options WHERE poll_id = ?', (p['id'],)).fetchall()] return polls @app.post('/api/polls') def create_poll(p: PollCreate): with get_conn() as c: cur = c.execute('INSERT INTO polls (question) VALUES (?)', (p.question,)) pid = cur.lastrowid for opt in p.options: c.execute('INSERT INTO options (poll_id, text) VALUES (?, ?)', (pid, opt)) return {'id': pid} @app.post('/api/options/{opt_id}/vote') def vote(opt_id: int): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('UPDATE options SET votes = votes + 1 WHERE id = ?', (opt_id,)) return {'voted': True} Quick Polls

Build a URL Shortener with Click Analytics using FastAPI and SQLite. Users can submit long URLs and generate short alphanumeric slugs. When users visit the short URL, increment its click counter and redirect to the target destination. Provide an analytics table showing links and hit counts. Structure:
- database.py: SQLite setup for urls table.
- main.py: FastAPI app with redirect logic and REST endpoints.

import sqlite3 def get_conn(): c = sqlite3.connect('urls.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS urls ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, slug TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, clicks INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )''') from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, HTTPException from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pydantic import BaseModel from database import get_conn, init_db import secrets app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class UrlCreate(BaseModel): url: str @app.get('/') def home(req: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': req}) @app.get('/r/{slug}') def redirect_url(slug: str): with get_conn() as c: row = c.execute('SELECT target FROM urls WHERE slug = ?', (slug,)).fetchone() if not row: raise HTTPException(status_code=404) c.execute('UPDATE urls SET clicks = clicks + 1 WHERE slug = ?', (slug,)) return RedirectResponse(url=row['target']) @app.get('/api/urls') def list_urls(): with get_conn() as c: return [dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM urls ORDER BY id DESC').fetchall()] @app.post('/api/shorten') def shorten(u: UrlCreate): slug = secrets.token_urlsafe(4) with get_conn() as c: c.execute('INSERT INTO urls (slug, target) VALUES (?, ?)', (slug, u.url)) return {'slug': slug, 'target': u.url} URL Minifier

import sqlite3 def get_db(): c = sqlite3.connect('forum.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_db() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS threads ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, author TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )''') c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, thread_id INTEGER NOT NULL, author TEXT NOT NULL, comment TEXT NOT NULL )''') from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify from database import get_db, init_db app = Flask(__name__) init_db() @app.route('/') def index(): return render_template('index.html') @app.route('/api/threads') def get_threads(): with get_db() as c: threads = [dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM threads ORDER BY id DESC').fetchall()] for t in threads: t['reply_count'] = c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE thread_id = ?', (t['id'],)).fetchone()[0] return jsonify(threads) @app.route('/api/threads', methods=['POST']) def create_thread(): d = request.json with get_db() as c: cur = c.execute('INSERT INTO threads (title, author, content) VALUES (?,?,?)', (d['title'], d['author'], d['content'])) return jsonify({'id': cur.lastrowid}), 201 @app.route('/api/threads//comments', methods=['GET', 'POST']) def thread_comments(tid): with get_db() as c: if request.method == 'POST': d = request.json c.execute('INSERT INTO comments (thread_id, author, comment) VALUES (?,?,?)', (tid, d['author'], d['comment'])) return jsonify({'ok': True}), 201 return jsonify([dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM comments WHERE thread_id = ?', (tid,)).fetchall()]) Dev Community Forum

import sqlite3 def get_conn(): c = sqlite3.connect('qa.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS questions ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, author TEXT DEFAULT 'Anonymous', question TEXT NOT NULL, upvotes INTEGER DEFAULT 0, answered INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )''') from fastapi import FastAPI, Request from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pydantic import BaseModel from database import get_conn, init_db app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class QuestionCreate(BaseModel): author: str = 'Anonymous' question: str @app.get('/') def home(req: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': req}) @app.get('/api/questions') def list_questions(): with get_conn() as c: return [dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM questions ORDER BY upvotes DESC, id DESC').fetchall()] @app.post('/api/questions') def ask(q: QuestionCreate): with get_conn() as c: cur = c.execute('INSERT INTO questions (author, question) VALUES (?, ?)', (q.author, q.question)) return {'id': cur.lastrowid} @app.post('/api/questions/{qid}/upvote') def upvote(qid: int): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('UPDATE questions SET upvotes = upvotes + 1 WHERE id = ?', (qid,)) return {'ok': True} Live Stage Q&A

Scott Fitzgerald'), ('To Kill a Mockingbird', 'Harper Lee'), ('1984', 'George Orwell') ]) from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify from database import get_db, init_db app = Flask(__name__) init_db() @app.route('/') def index(): return render_template('index.html') @app.route('/api/books') def list_books(): with get_db() as c: return jsonify([dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM books').fetchall()]) @app.route('/api/books//checkout', methods=['POST']) def checkout(bid): name = request.json.get('borrower') with get_db() as c: c.execute('UPDATE books SET is_available = 0, borrower = ? instruction:
Create a User Authentication & Profile Portal using Flask and SQLite. Support user registration (username, password hash using hashlib), login with session tokens, and a protected profile dashboard displaying user account creation time. Structure:
- database.py: SQLite setup for users table.
- app.py: Flask routes for register, login, logout, and profile.
- templates/index.html: Unified auth view with login/register tabs and authenticated dashboard.
- static/style.css: Modern security portal styling.
- static/script.js: Client-side session management and token persistence.

import sqlite3 def get_db(): c = sqlite3.connect('auth.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_db() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )''') from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify from database import get_db, init_db import hashlib, secrets app = Flask(__name__) init_db() sessions = {} def hash_pw(pw): return hashlib.sha256(pw.encode()).hexdigest() @app.route('/') def home(): return render_template('index.html') @app.route('/api/register', methods=['POST']) def register(): d = request.json try: with get_db() as c: c.execute('INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash) VALUES (?, ?)', (d['username'], hash_pw(d['password']))) return jsonify({'ok': True}), 201 except Exception: return jsonify({'error': 'Username already taken'}), 400 @app.route('/api/login', methods=['POST']) def login(): d = request.json with get_db() as c: u = c.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ? AND password_hash = ?', (d['username'], hash_pw(d['password']))).fetchone() if not u: return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid credentials'}), 401 tok = secrets.token_hex(16) sessions[tok] = u['username'] return jsonify({'token': tok, 'username': u['username']}) @app.route('/api/me') def me(): tok = request.headers.get('Authorization') user = sessions.get(tok) if not user: return jsonify({'error': 'Unauthorized'}), 401 return jsonify({'username': user}) Auth Portal

Account Portal

Welcome, !

You are authenticated into the secure portal.

Now please log in.'); } function logout() { localStorage.removeItem('tok'); location.reload(); } check();

import sqlite3 def get_conn(): c = sqlite3.connect('vault.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS credentials ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, service TEXT NOT NULL, username TEXT NOT NULL, secret TEXT NOT NULL )''') from fastapi import FastAPI, Request from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pydantic import BaseModel from database import get_conn, init_db app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class Cred(BaseModel): service: str username: str secret: str @app.get('/') def home(req: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': req}) @app.get('/api/creds') def get_creds(): with get_conn() as c: return [dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM credentials').fetchall()] @app.post('/api/creds') def add_cred(cr: Cred): with get_conn() as c: cur = c.execute('INSERT INTO credentials (service, username, secret) VALUES (?,?,?)', (cr.service, cr.username, cr.secret)) return {'id': cur.lastrowid} @app.delete('/api/creds/{cid}') def del_cred(cid: int): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('DELETE FROM credentials WHERE id = ?', (cid,)) return {'deleted': cid} Vault Stash

import sqlite3 def get_conn(): c = sqlite3.connect('auction.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, current_bid REAL NOT NULL, highest_bidder TEXT DEFAULT 'Starting Price' )''') if c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items').fetchone()[0] == 0: c.executemany('INSERT INTO items (title, current_bid) VALUES (?,?)', [ ('Antique Brass Pocket Watch', 150.0), ('Signed 1982 First Edition Novel', 300.0), ('Vintage Film Camera & 50mm Lens', 220.0) ]) from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, HTTPException from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pydantic import BaseModel from database import get_conn, init_db app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class Bid(BaseModel): bidder: str amount: float @app.get('/') def index(req: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': req}) @app.get('/api/items') def get_items(): with get_conn() as c: return [dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM items').fetchall()] @app.post('/api/items/{item_id}/bid') def place_bid(item_id: int, b: Bid): with get_conn() as c: row = c.execute('SELECT current_bid FROM items WHERE id = ?', (item_id,)).fetchone() if not row or b.amount <= row['current_bid']: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Bid must be higher than current bid') c.execute('UPDATE items SET current_bid = ?, highest_bidder = ? WHERE id = ?', (b.amount, b.bidder, item_id)) return {'ok': True} Sotheby Auctions

import sqlite3 def get_conn(): c = sqlite3.connect('events.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, location TEXT NOT NULL, event_date DATE NOT NULL, capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, booked INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )''') if c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events').fetchone()[0] == 0: c.executemany('INSERT INTO events (title, location, event_date, capacity) VALUES (?,?,?,?)', [ ('Tech Summit 2026', 'Convention Center Hall A', '2026-11-15', 100), ('Indie Indie Film Night', 'Downtown Cinema', '2026-10-05', 40) ]) from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, HTTPException from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pydantic import BaseModel from database import get_conn, init_db app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class RSVP(BaseModel): name: str email: str @app.get('/') def home(req: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': req}) @app.get('/api/events') def list_events(): with get_conn() as c: return [dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY event_date ASC').fetchall()] @app.post('/api/events/{event_id}/rsvp') def book_seat(event_id: int, rsvp: RSVP): with get_conn() as c: row = c.execute('SELECT booked, capacity FROM events WHERE id = ?', (event_id,)).fetchone() if not row: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Event not found') if row['booked'] >= row['capacity']: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Event is fully booked!') c.execute('UPDATE events SET booked = booked + 1 WHERE id = ?', (event_id,)) return {'message': 'RSVP confirmed!'} TicketStream

import sqlite3 def get_conn(): c = sqlite3.connect('uptime.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS monitors ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, url TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'Online', latency INTEGER DEFAULT 45 )''') if c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monitors').fetchone()[0] == 0: c.executemany('INSERT INTO monitors (name, url, status, latency) VALUES (?,?,?,?)', [ ('Primary API Gateway', 'https://api.cloud.io', 'Online', 32), ('Auth Service', 'https://auth.cloud.io', 'Online', 28), ('Database Replica 02', 'db-replica.internal', 'Degraded', 180) ]) from fastapi import FastAPI, Request from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pydantic import BaseModel import random from database import get_conn, init_db app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class Monitor(BaseModel): name: str url: str @app.get('/') def index(req: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': req}) @app.get('/api/monitors') def get_monitors(): with get_conn() as c: return [dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM monitors').fetchall()] @app.post('/api/monitors') def add_monitor(m: Monitor): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('INSERT INTO monitors (name, url) VALUES (?,?)', (m.name, m.url)) return {'ok': True} @app.post('/api/monitors/{mid}/ping') def ping(mid: int): lat = random.randint(20, 150) st = 'Online' if lat < 120 else 'Degraded' with get_conn() as c: c.execute('UPDATE monitors SET latency = ?, status = ? WHERE id = ?', (lat, st, mid)) return {'latency': lat, 'status': st} NOC Uptime Pulse

import sqlite3 def get_conn(): c = sqlite3.connect('bikerepair.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tickets ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, customer TEXT NOT NULL, bike TEXT NOT NULL, service TEXT NOT NULL, cost REAL NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'Queued' )''') from fastapi import FastAPI, Request from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from pydantic import BaseModel from database import get_conn, init_db app = FastAPI() init_db() app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory='static'), name='static') templates = Jinja2Templates(directory='templates') class Ticket(BaseModel): customer: str bike: str service: str cost: float @app.get('/') def index(req: Request): return templates.TemplateResponse('index.html', {'request': req}) @app.get('/api/tickets') def get_tickets(): with get_conn() as c: return [dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM tickets ORDER BY id DESC').fetchall()] @app.post('/api/tickets') def add_ticket(t: Ticket): with get_conn() as c: c.execute('INSERT INTO tickets (customer, bike, service, cost) VALUES (?,?,?,?)', (t.customer, t.bike, t.service, t.cost)) return {'ok': True} @app.post('/api/tickets/{tid}/advance') def advance_ticket(tid: int): with get_conn() as c: curr = c.execute('SELECT status FROM tickets WHERE id = ?', (tid,)).fetchone()['status'] nxt = 'In Stand' if curr == 'Queued' else 'Ready for Pickup' c.execute('UPDATE tickets SET status = ? WHERE id = ?', (nxt, tid)) return {'status': nxt} Velocipede Bike Service

Build a Self-Hosted Read-Later Queue & Bookmarklet Saver using Flask and SQLite. Users save web articles to read later (page title, URL target, reading time estimate in minutes, archive status). Files:

import sqlite3 def get_db(): c = sqlite3.connect('readlater.db') c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return c def init_db(): with get_db() as c: c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS queue ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, url TEXT NOT NULL, read_time INTEGER NOT NULL, archived INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )''') if c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM queue').fetchone()[0] == 0: c.executemany('INSERT INTO queue (title, url, read_time) VALUES (?,?,?)', [ ('The Future of Generative Software Engineering', 'https://tech.blog/future-se', 8), ('Why SQLite in Production is Underestimated', 'https://database.guide/sqlite', 5) ]) from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify from database import get_db, init_db app = Flask(__name__) init_db() @app.route('/') def index(): return render_template('index.html') @app.route('/api/queue') def get_queue(): with get_db() as c: return jsonify([dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM queue WHERE archived = 0 ORDER BY id DESC').fetchall()]) @app.route('/api/queue', methods=['POST']) def add_item(): d = request.json with get_db() as c: c.execute('INSERT INTO queue (title, url, read_time) VALUES (?,?,?)', (d['title'], d['url'], int(d['read_time']))) return jsonify({'ok': True}), 201 @app.route('/api/queue//archive', methods=['POST']) def archive_item(qid): with get_db() as c: c.execute('UPDATE queue SET archived = 1 WHERE id = ?', (qid,)) return jsonify({'ok': True}) PocketStack Reader
